description: This file defines a Java interface 'ClientActorPropsFactory' that declares a method for creating Akka actor Props based on a Connection object. It specifies the contract for generating actor configurations for messaging components within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity services.
external_methods: Props getActorPropsForType(Connection connection, @Nullable ActorRef proxyActor, ActorRef connectionActor)

classes.name: ClientActorPropsFactory
classes.description: An interface responsible for producing Akka actor Props objects for given Connection instances, facilitating the creation of messaging actors in the system.

methods.name: getActorPropsForType
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object for the provided Connection, potentially using a proxy ActorRef and a connection ActorRef for messaging and persistence purposes.
